experiment: P5m user-authorized exclusive-window shared frozen-forward and dense bounded-head execution
research_question: With the frozen P5e five-model bounded-JNR candidate unchanged, does one shared frozen base forward preserve complete full-pool outputs exactly and reduce guarded per-inference-batch latency relative to two frozen base forwards?
single_changed_axis: Relative to the stopped P5l execution, the scientific mechanism, output contract, benchmark batch, warmups, repetitions and gates are unchanged.  P5m changes only the execution environment to the user-authorized exclusive CUDA window and uses fresh identities because P5l identities were consumed by its guard stop.

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: Proceed only inside the user-authorized no-other-CUDA-job window; record the failed mode-switch command and retain the before/after guard receipts.  Any external CUDA Python PID at any checkpoint invalidates P5m before a result.

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: all five power views remain together; every new pool must have zero overlap with all locally retained historical train identities

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125, no data-dependent sampling
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment
execution.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after every call.  Guard before/after full-pool equivalence and every warmup/repeat; reject any external Python PID whose nvidia-smi pmon type contains C.

stop_rule: If the mode-change attempt is denied, continue only under the recorded user-authorized exclusive window.  Any external CUDA Python PID, exception, output non-equivalence or latency-gate failure freezes the P5m identities with no result claim and no implementation, head, feature, batch, scheduling, compiler or quantization change.  Do not generate confirmation data unless every development gate passes.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a confirmation pass supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution per-batch cost claim.  It never establishes a new architecture or classification claim.
